steps.name: foundry-oidc refuses an empty or absent nonce, state or verifier
criteria: RED: unit tests in foundry-oidc fail today: exchange_code with an empty state, nonce or code_verifier returns Transport (reaches the network) instead of Untrusted; ensure_nonce("","") is accepted
GREEN: exchange_code refuses an empty state, nonce or code_verifier as OidcError::Untrusted before any provider call
GREEN: a pure ensure_nonce(expected, presented) refuses when either is empty or they differ; it replaces the inline comparison
The doc comment no longer calls the nonce an independent layer; serde(default) on the nonce claim is kept so a missing claim reaches ensure_nonce
keycloak-sso 38/38 and keycloak-sso-provisioning 15/15 stay green; fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-arch, smoke pass
steps.scenario_name: exchange_code refuses an empty nonce (unit regression)
steps.description: Approved fix (a)+(b)+(c) from docs/feature/fix-oidc-empty-nonce/rca.md: guard empty state/nonce/code_verifier at the top of exchange_code, require a non-empty matching nonce on both sides via a pure helper, and correct the 'independent second layer' doc comment. Refusals stay OidcError::Untrusted, so the app's single refuse() keeps them byte-identical to a wrong password (D7).
steps.implementation_notes: See rca.md for file:line evidence. No foundry-app change, no Gherkin, no new dev-dependencies (the optional HTTP integration test is out of scope). Unit tests live in lib.rs mod tests: empty-field refusals through exchange_code with an unroutable issuer must assert Untrusted (today Transport); a table test of ensure_nonce including the ("","") and ("x","") rows. Named faults to seed after GREEN: guard removed; ensure_nonce empty checks removed; ensure_nonce compares only presence. Real Keycloak manual sign-in is owed by the user after deploy. Build with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false; bound lane runs with timeout.

validation.note: User approved RCA fix direction (a)+(b)+(c) on 2026-10-04 via /nw-bugfix Phase 2.
